description: This file defines the SubscriptionStatus model class in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It provides methods to retrieve subscription status records from the database, including single and multiple records, with caching support.

classes.name: SubscriptionStatus
classes.description: Model class for managing subscription status records, enabling retrieval of individual and list of subscription statuses, with caching support.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Fetches a single subscription status record by its ID from the database.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves all subscription status records, utilizing caching for optimization.
